reviews.title: Great Performance
reviews.comment: Upgraded from ASRock B550 w/ AMD 3700X. Additional installs: GSkill Trident Z5 6000MT/s 32gb Corsair Nautilus 360 AIO My previous ASUS 3060 12gb GPU Corsair e850 PSU NZXT H6 Flow So far, such a big improvement, thought of adding another 32gb of RAM but not necessary. Zero lag with FH5, Hollow Knight, Still Wakes The Deep, and Minecraft. Incredibly happy with the build so far! Idle temps is 28c, load is 32-35c. For the review about Battlefield 6: Google it, they tell you on Intel's website how to sign up for the code, codes will be available 10/3/25 after registering on their website.
reviews.author: Adam
